description: Finance analyst asks about retention rate — same term, must resolve to transactions+funds, must use fiscal year (Jul 1 – Jun 30)

turns.content: What is our retention rate this year?

ground_truth.rule_applied: fiscal year is July 1 – June 30, NOT calendar year
